about_the_game:
192X. As summer draws near, Parisian students are revising their end-of-year exams. Olivier is one of them. For years, he has been walking to school every morning with his dearest childhood friend, and has unwound with his artistic peers after class. In a week, this routine will come to a close. And recent revelations already threaten Olivier’s comfortable life.

This game is currently in development. Current graphics do not reflect the final result. The game will release simultaneously in both English and French.

Features

  • 3 routes and a half, with various choices that may or may not have consequences

  • 70k word count (around 25k/30k words per route)

  • 25 items and 21 character portraits to collect, and achievements to unlock!

  • Historical urban fantasy of the angel variety...?

content_descriptors.notes:
Content warnings and disclaimers (may contain spoilers): Alcohol abuse, bullying mentions, parental abuse, religious themes, strong language, suicidal tendencies, war mentions.

There are no death scenes/endings. The views of the characters do not reflect those of the developer.
